grouping: Exact curve_id. Sort curve IDs by SHA256('curve-holdout-20261018|'+curve_id); first4 train,next3 calibrate,last2 test. No curve crosses a split.
model: same fixed random-forest64/max_depth8/min_samples_leaf2; completed-cell maximum D_solve and log2 counted cost as separate responses
conformal_unit: curve; take maximum absolute residual per calibration curve. A 90% finite-sample interval needs ceil((k+1)*0.9)<=k; otherwise interval unbounded.
claim: Report heldout per-cell error and descriptive coverage only. With three calibration curves the 90% group interval is correctly unbounded. Historical curves remain nonrandom, so no exchangeability guarantee is asserted.
